name: NEC Hiroshima Data Center
notes: NEC official page describes the Hiroshima data center as a core Chugoku/Shikoku-region continuity facility on elevated ground in Hiroshima, with resilient power, cooling, and security features; MW not disclosed.

name: EneWings Hiroshima Data Center
notes: Enecom official pages identify EneWings Hiroshima Data Center as the company's third Chugoku-region data center in Hiroshima City Higashi Ward; facility page lists about 13,000 sqm GFA, 22kV dual-substation receiving, 72-hour generators, and up to 20kVA rack power.

name: Hokkaido Tomakomai AI Data Center
notes: SoftBank says construction began for the Tomakomai AI data center, operations are scheduled for FY2026, the site covers about 700,000 sqm, and power capacity is expected to exceed 300MW; DCD reports an initial 50MW phase and potential expansion beyond 300MW.

name: Ishikari Renewable Energy Data Center No. 1
developer: Tokyu Land Corporation; Flower Communications; Ishikari Renewable Energy Data Center LLC No.1
notes: Tokyu Land and project pages list the Ishikari renewable-energy data center in Ishikari City, Hokkaido, with March 2026 completion, six sections/data halls, and 15MW receiving capacity; Shizen Energy says construction was completed March 27, 2026.

name: SAKURA internet Ishikari container-type AI data center expansion
notes: SAKURA internet announced operation of a container-type data center at Ishikari to meet generative AI GPU demand; Hokkaido's data-center promotion site separately notes Sakura's 100B+ yen AI cloud infrastructure investment at Ishikari. MW not disclosed.

name: White Data Center Bibai
developer: White Data Center; Bibai City-related project
notes: Japanese government publicity and DCD describe a snow-cooled data center in Bibai, Hokkaido, operating commercially from 2021 and using stored snow/meltwater for cooling; MW not disclosed.

name: NEC Kobe Data Center Phase 3 Building
notes: NEC announced the Kobe Phase 3 green data center in 2022 for first-half 2024 operation; NEC technical reporting says NEC opened the Kobe Data Center Phase 3 Building in May 2024. MW not disclosed.

name: NEC Kobe Data Center campus
notes: NEC official service page identifies Kobe Data Center as its flagship western Japan data center offering cloud and colocation; DCD notes NEC launched new data center buildings at Kobe and Kanagawa campuses in May 2024.

name: Fujitsu Akashi System Center modular data center facilities
notes: Fujitsu announced two modular data center facilities went into operation at Akashi System Center in Hyogo, described as the company's main data center serving western Japan; MW not disclosed.

name: Goodman Tsukuba Tech Central / Tsukuba Data Centre Campus
notes: Goodman announced infrastructure works for 1,000MW of power at a new Tsukuba City, Greater Tokyo campus; the first 50MW facility was due in 2026 under a heads of agreement. Official TYO05 page identifies Tsukuba Tech Central as Goodman's next-generation data center and technology campus in Tsukuba City.

name: Kitaibaraki data center candidate sites
notes: Kitaibaraki City published guidance for data center candidate sites in response to national policy supporting regional digital infrastructure. This is site promotion rather than a named operator project; capacity not disclosed.

name: HIGHRESO Shika-machi GPU Data Center
notes: SAKURA internet and Toyota Tsusho official pages state HIGHRESO has operated a GPU-dedicated data center in Shika Town, Ishikawa since 2019 for GPUSOROBAN GPU cloud services; MW not disclosed.

name: HIGHRESO Shika-machi second data center expansion
notes: Aggregator listings report HIGHRESO's Shika-machi, Ishikawa data center was expanded in August 2022 with a second facility, one of Japan's largest GPU-dedicated data centers; retained as lower-grade evidence because no primary page with the expansion details was found.

name: NTT East Iwate Data Center
developer: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone East Corporation
notes: NTT East Iwate announced service start for its Iwate Data Center in Morioka on April 23, 2012; JDCC data center list also includes NTT East's Iwate Data Center. MW not disclosed.

name: ICS Data Center
notes: ICS official page describes an Iwate/Morioka-area data center with about 1,300 sqm gross floor area and space for about 240 racks, positioned for remote backup/BCP; MW not disclosed.

name: HIGHRESO Kagawa / Takamatsu City GPU Data Center
developer: HIGHRESO Kagawa Co., Ltd.; HIGHRESO Co., Ltd.
notes: NVIDIA said HIGHRESO's H200-powered Kagawa data center was expected to begin operations in the following month; Toyota Tsusho later states HIGHRESO operates GPU-dedicated AI development data centers in Shika, Ishikawa and Takamatsu, Kagawa. MW not disclosed.

name: STNet Powerico Data Center
notes: STNet official page describes Powerico as a high-spec JDCC Tier 4-equivalent data center in Kagawa; Shimizu lists completion in October 2013 and 11,225 sqm floor area, and AT TOKYO announced an access point there in 2024.

name: NTT DOCOMO Business Takamatsu 2 Data Center
notes: Official Nexcenter page identifies Takamatsu 2 Data Center in Takamatsu City, Kagawa, as a purpose-built four-story, seismically isolated data center with 66kV receiving and 72-hour gas turbine generator backup; MW not disclosed.

name: Kai Shin Digital Infrastructure Satsumasendai AI Data Center
developer: Kai Shin Digital Infrastructure Inc.; CDIB Capital Group; Shinetsu Science Industry
notes: Satsumasendai City says it signed a location agreement with Kai Shin Digital Infrastructure on July 18, 2026 for an AI data center in Circular Park Kyushu, starting with demonstration operation and expanding in stages to a cumulative 350MW; planned investment about 850B yen.

name: GMI Cloud Kagoshima AI Factory
developer: GMI Cloud; Kai Shin Digital Infrastructure; Wistron; VAST Data partners
notes: GMI Cloud announced a $12B AI Factory in Kagoshima intended to scale to 1GW, located in a development initiated by Kai Shin Digital Infrastructure with Kagoshima Prefecture and Satsumasendai support; development expected to start in late 2026.

name: NEC Kanagawa Data Center Phase 2 Building
notes: NEC announced the Kanagawa Phase 2 green data center for second-half 2023 opening, and later technical reporting says NEC opened the Kanagawa Data Center Phase 2 Building in May 2024; MW not disclosed.

name: Goodman Sagamihara data centre campus
notes: Goodman announced it had been selected as lead development partner for local landowners and stakeholders advancing a potential data center campus in Sagamihara City, Kanagawa Prefecture; capacity not yet disclosed.

name: Mitsui acquired operational hyperscale data center in Kanagawa
developer: Mitsui & Co. Asset Management Holdings; undisclosed operating asset
notes: Mitsui official release says its subsidiary agreed to acquire a 50% stake in an operational hyperscale data center in Kanagawa Prefecture with about 20MW power capacity, as a seed asset for a future data center core fund.

name: Fujitsu Yokohama Data Center
notes: Fujitsu announced private 5G field trials at its Yokohama Data Center in Yokohama City, Kanagawa; current Fujitsu data center brochure identifies Yokohama Kohoku Data Center as part of Fujitsu Data Center Services. MW not disclosed.

name: IDC Frontier Kanagawa Yokohama Data Center
notes: IDC Frontier official pages list the Kanagawa Yokohama Data Center in the Yokohama Bay Area among its nationwide self-managed data center locations; MW not disclosed.

name: Kochi Computing Center Data Center
notes: Kochi Computing Center official page offers data center services including housing and hosting, with UPS, emergency generators, 24/365 monitoring, biometric access controls, and gas fire suppression; MW not disclosed.

name: Fujitsu Shikoku Data Center A / Nankoku Office Park IDC
notes: Fujitsu announced construction of a Nankoku Office Park facility including its first Shikoku internet data center, planned for September 2003; JDCC list identifies Fujitsu Shikoku Data Center A in Nankoku, Kochi, opened 2003, Tier 3 equivalent, 517 sqm.
